change: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens on the paid Gemini API. Hydrogen is also on the API free tier.
Fish Audio launched Fish Agent, a no-code builder for AI voice agents. Its pricing docs set $0.07 per minute of conversation. Calls on a Fish phone number add $0.01 a minute.
Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available to paying developers at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. Its pricing page shows both rates doubling to $4 and $20.
Meta released Muse Ember at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens. Prompts over 200K tokens cost three times as much.
Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, 20% below the $10 and $50 that Claude Fable 5.1 still lists.
OpenAI opened outbound SIP calling to all organizations through the Live API. You bring your own SIP trunk. GPT-Live voice time costs $0.05 a minute, billed per second.
Google deprecated Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 2.5 Flash. From December 1 requests that name them are answered by gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.5-flash-lite, each billed at the new model's rates.

place: ChatGPT Pro and Business API credits
change: Eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can claim up to $500 a month in free OpenAI API credits by linking an API organization they own. Unused credits expire at the end of each billing cycle.
OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens, which OpenAI says is 50 percent below the standard prices of GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol.
New Gemini API projects on the paid tier store Generate Content API requests by default. The logs expire after 55 days unless the window is shortened to 7, 14 or 28 days or storage is turned off.
Meta will stop accepting WhatsApp marketing messages through the Cloud API. From that date every promotional template has to go out through the Marketing Messages API for WhatsApp.
OpenAI now lets developers keep a cached prompt for 12 hours instead of the default 30 minutes. The longer cache costs 2.5 times the model's input price to write, against 1.25 times for the default.

place: DeepSeek Search API and Fetch API
change: DeepSeek opened its Search API and its Fetch API to everyone. Each costs $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests.
OpenAI made prompt-to-voice available to every API customer. A saved custom voice for GPT-Live is free to create, with speech billed at the normal session rate.
Anthropic took fast mode for Claude Opus 5.5 out of research preview. Fast mode costs $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, twice the standard $4 and $20.
xAI released Grok Voice 3.0 and kept the price at $0.08 per minute of audio, or $4.80 an hour, in its Voice Agent API, the same rate it charges for Grok Voice 2.0. Grok Voice 2.0 is deprecated.

place: GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1 mini (API)
change: OpenAI will switch off GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1 mini in its API. It names GPT-6 Luna as the replacement for all four.
Google made Gemini 4 Argon generally available at an introductory price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. From December 1 the same model costs $4 and $20.

Google Local Services Ads now charges for a missed call if the caller stays on the line for more than 20 seconds during business hours, even if nobody calls back. A June 15, 2026 copy of the page had no such rule.
OpenAI's Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol opened to all API users. It costs $12 per million input tokens and $60 per million output tokens, six times the Standard rate of $2 and $10.

Claude Max and Team subscriptions now include a monthly credit for the Claude API: $100 on Max 5x, $200 on Max 20x, and $20 per Standard or $100 per Premium Team seat, pooled and capped at $500 a month.
Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens for prompts up to 100,000 tokens, 90% below Haiku 4.5's $1 and $5.

OpenAI replaced its five numbered API usage tiers with three named ones. Build opens at $5 in total credit purchases with a $500 monthly usage limit, Launch at $100 with $5,000 and Grow at $500 with $200,000.

Microsoft released MAI-Voice-2.1 at $22 per million characters and MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash at $15, with MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming at an introductory $0.54 per hour of audio through the end of 2026. All are in public preview.

HubSpot's new EMEA customers pay from €20 a month for a GTM seat on Starter, €100 on Professional and €175 on Enterprise. Every marketing email also draws credits: 15 a send, or €0.15, in the first tier.
Microsoft's deprecation of Exchange Web Services in Exchange Online began. Tenant disablements had started by 21 October.
Apify rental Actors are fully retired on 1 October 2026. All remaining Actors are migrated to pay-per-usage pricing.
Retell moved its remaining monthly-invoice workspaces to prepaid credits, while Enterprise workspaces stay on monthly invoices. Calls, chat and other usage stop when the credit balance reaches zero.
Anthropic notified developers that Claude Sonnet 4.5 retires on the Claude API, with claude-sonnet-5-5 as the recommended replacement. After that date requests to it fail.

place: Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo
change: Eleven v4 Turbo lists at $0.04 per 1,000 characters and costs $0.011 until October 12, 2026 under a 72 percent launch discount. Eleven v4 lists at $0.08 and is $0.022 until the same date.
GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna were released at half the per-token price of the GPT-5.6 models they replace. Sol is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output, Luna 10 cents and 50 cents.
ElevenLabs launched Reception, a self-serve AI receptionist for small businesses built on ElevenAgents. Plans run from Basic at $29 a month to Premium at $199 a month.
HubSpot announced the end of support for v1 to v3 APIs, with an enforcement date of September 2027. Support for v4 is ending on its own earlier timeline, 30 March 2027.

HubSpot legacy private app creation is switched off on 28 September 2026 for new accounts and 26 October 2026 for existing ones. Legacy private apps must migrate to the Projects based private app model.

OpenAI plans to retire custom GPTs across ChatGPT plans and offer a migration path to plugins. The scheduled retirement date is December 11, 2026, with February 11, 2027 only for Enterprise workspaces with an approved deferral.
HighLevel raises the carrier fees it passes through on US messaging. Verizon outbound SMS goes from $0.0045 to $0.0050 per message and the Other carrier category from $0.0040 to $0.0042.

Google's introductory price for Gemini 3.8 Flash ends on December 31, 2026. From January 1, 2027 the model costs $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, twice today's $0.75 and $3.75.
xAI priced Grok Voice 2.0 at $0.08 a minute when it launched the model. That rate is 60 percent above the $0.05 a minute xAI listed in early July.
Anthropic consolidated Claude API Tiers 1 to 4 into Start, Build and Scale and raised Sonnet and Haiku to Opus's limits at every tier.
